item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 11/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the easterly airstream moderating over the weekend, it will be warm during the day over Guangdong. It will be relatively humid in the morning and at night. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cloudier with slightly cooler weather over the region.
